outcome: time to atrial septal defect creation
cohort: The cohort consisted of 128 neonates with hypoplastic left heart syndrome variants with an intact or highly restrictive atrial septum (HLH-IAS) who underwent left atrial decompression in the first 36 hours of life.
finding: Hybrid left atrial decompression (LAD) was associated with faster atrial septal defect creation, a higher technical success rate, and potentially fewer serious adverse events compared to percutaneous LAD in neonates with HLH-IAS, although long-term survival remained comparably low between groups.
